22.name: BfR — Frequently asked questions about solanine in potatoes
22.note_es: El BfR explica que los brotes y ojos concentran glicoalcaloides y recomienda no consumir patatas viejas o fuertemente brotadas.
22.note_en: BfR explains that sprouts and eyes concentrate glycoalkaloids and advises against eating old or strongly sprouting potatoes.

23.name: BfR — Frequently asked questions about solanine in potatoes
23.note_es: Relaciona las zonas verdes con mayor contenido de glicoalcaloides y recoge recomendaciones de almacenamiento y preparación.
23.note_en: Links green areas with elevated glycoalkaloid content and provides storage and preparation recommendations.

25.name: PubMed — Avocado intake and body weight: systematic review and meta-analysis
25.note_es: Metaanálisis de ensayos aleatorizados: el consumo de aguacate no promovió aumento de peso frente a los controles.
25.note_en: Meta-analysis of randomized trials found avocado consumption did not promote weight gain compared with controls.

143.name: MedlinePlus — Dietary Fiber
143.note_es: MedlinePlus señala que aumentar la fibra demasiado rápido puede provocar gases, hinchazón y cólicos.
143.note_en: MedlinePlus notes that increasing dietary fiber too quickly can cause gas, bloating, and cramps.

145.name: USDA FSIS — Molds on Food: Are They Dangerous?
145.note_es: Guía detallada sobre cuándo desechar alimentos con moho y cuándo puede recortarse una parte de alimentos firmes.
145.note_en: Detailed guidance on when moldy foods should be discarded and when mold can be trimmed from firm foods.

150.name: USDA FSIS — Leftovers and Food Safety
150.note_es: Recomienda enfriar y refrigerar las sobras con rapidez y recalentarlas hasta 165 °F/73,9 °C.
150.note_en: Recommends prompt cooling/refrigeration of leftovers and reheating them to 165°F/73.9°C.

428.name: USDA FSIS — Molds on Food: Are They Dangerous?
428.note_es: USDA distingue el pan simplemente duro del pan con moho: el pan y los productos horneados con moho deben desecharse.
428.note_en: USDA distinguishes staling from mold risk: moldy bread and baked goods should be discarded.

445.name: Penn State Extension — Preparing and Preserving Mushrooms
445.note_es: Explica selección, almacenamiento refrigerado y señales de calidad/deterioro en champiñones frescos.
445.note_en: Covers selection, refrigerated storage, and quality/spoilage considerations for fresh mushrooms.

450.name: USDA FSIS — Molds on Food: Are They Dangerous?
450.note_es: USDA recomienda desechar frutas blandas con moho porque la contaminación puede extenderse bajo la superficie.
450.note_en: USDA advises discarding moldy soft fruit because contamination can extend below the surface.

458.name: FoodSafety.gov — Cold Food Storage Chart
458.note_es: Referencia federal de conservación en frío y plazos domésticos para alimentos refrigerados.
458.note_en: Federal cold-storage reference with household refrigeration time limits.

482.name: FDA — Gluten and Food Labeling
482.note_es: Explica qué cereales contienen gluten y los requisitos para usar la declaración 'gluten-free', incluido el control de contacto cruzado.
482.note_en: Explains gluten-containing grains and the requirements for a gluten-free claim, including unavoidable cross-contact.

487.name: FoodSafety.gov — Cold Food Storage Chart
487.note_es: Aporta el marco federal de conservación refrigerada para sobras y otros alimentos cocinados.
487.note_en: Provides federal refrigerated-storage guidance for leftovers and other cooked foods.

1133.name: FDA — Microwave Ovens
1133.note_es: FDA indica que, en general, no deben usarse recipientes metálicos ni papel de aluminio porque reflejan las microondas y pueden dañar el horno.
1133.note_en: FDA says metal pans and aluminum foil generally should not be used because they reflect microwaves and may damage the oven.
